title: polybotrya prolifera
intro: Polybotrya prolifera, commonly known as the many-branched fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. The plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, and it is said to have health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Polybotrya prolifera include its use in treating coughs, colds, and bronchitis, as well as its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
